location.description: The store, business, or venue name printed on the receipt — where the purchase happened. Use "Unknown" if unreadable, "Not a receipt" if the image is not a receipt.

date.description: Purchase date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Empty string if no date is visible.

state.description: US state (or non-US region) printed in the receipt's address block. Use the two-letter postal code for US states (e.g. "CA", "NY"). Empty string if not visible.

city.description: City printed in the receipt's address block. Empty string if not visible.

items.description: Every line item on the receipt, in the order printed. One entry per purchased product or service. Empty array if no line items are legible.

item.description: The item name or description exactly as printed on the receipt.

price.description: The amount charged for this line (the line total), as a plain number with no currency symbol.

item_type.description: The category of this individual item.
